papers.title_en: GeoTrain: Energy-Aware Automatic Parallelism for Foundation Model Training on Heterogeneous Geo-Distributed Resources
papers.authors: Bui-Khanh Hoang, TianZhang He, Mohammad Goudarzi
papers.evidence: 面向地理分布式GPU的能耗感知自动并行化
papers.tldr: 前沿基础模型训练依赖昂贵的集中式高速集群，而汇聚地理分散GPU虽更易获得，却受算力、显存、功耗和网络异构制约，慢设备与弱链路会拖累整体训练。GeoTrain联合决定参与GPU、模型层切分和流水线配置，并将迭代时间与能耗一并纳入优化。其采用带专用遗传算子和局部搜索的改进模因算法搜索组合空间。在真实及模拟拓扑的解码器式Transformer实验中，相较现有方法最多降低61.4%迭代时间和11.7%能耗，为去中心化训练提供可扩展的能时协同自动并行方案。
papers.abstract_en: Training foundation models at the frontier typically requires large-scale dedicated and centralized clusters with fast interconnects - infrastructure that is prohibitively expensive and generally accessible only to well-resourced organizations. Decentralized training over pooled, geographically distributed GPUs offers an alternative, but introduces substantial heterogeneity in compute, memory, power, and network performance. Existing distributed training systems are primarily designed for clusters with fast, low-latency interconnects and typically use all available GPUs when configuring parallel training. In geo-distributed environments, however, slower devices and weak network links can become bottlenecks, while optimizing solely for throughput overlooks significant energy cost.   We present GeoTrain, an automatic parallelism system that jointly optimizes training performance and energy consumption for heterogeneous geo-distributed GPU environments. GeoTrain simultaneously selects GPUs, partitions model layers, and determines pipeline configurations while accounting for heterogeneous compute, memory, power, and network constraints. To efficiently explore this large combinatorial search space, GeoTrain employs an optimized memetic algorithm with specialized genetic operators and local search. Experiments with decoder-only Transformer models on real-world and simulated heterogeneous topologies demonstrate that GeoTrain reduces iteration time and energy consumption by up to $61.4\%$ and $11.7\%$, respectively, over the existing state-of-the-art approaches. It also finds the exact optimum on verifiable instances and scales beyond exact methods as the number of GPUs increases, while exposing favorable energy-time trade-offs, including cases where its time-optimal distributed training plan is both faster and more energy-efficient than the baselines.

papers.title_en: Bridging Compressed Communication and Local Steps via Spectral Method in Federated Learning
papers.authors: Dmitriy Bystrov, George Chirkov, Daniil Medyakov, Dmitry Bylinkin, Aleksandr Beznosikov
papers.evidence: 结合压缩通信与本地更新的联邦训练方法
papers.tldr: 联邦学习虽能在数据不出端的条件下协同训练，但数据异质性与通信开销限制了大规模部署；现有将谱优化器 Muon 引入联邦学习的方案，难以同时兼容本地多步更新和通信压缩。论文提出新的谱式联邦优化方法，联合利用本地更新与压缩通信，并在温和假设下给出收敛保证。理论上无需常见的有界异质性条件，实验在标准图像分类任务上验证了其效率与鲁棒性，为高效谱优化联邦训练提供了路径。
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of complex models across large-scale networks of edge devices while keeping data localized. However, data heterogeneity and high communication overhead remain fundamental bottlenecks. Recently, the spectral optimizer Muon has demonstrated remarkable advantages over Adam-like methods in centralized training. While recent efforts have attempted to transition Muon to FL, naive integrations into traditional architectures fail short. Crucially, existing approaches do not support the the communication compression and local steps --- the two foundational techniques of efficient FL. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel spectral FL method that utilizes both local updates and compression. We establish rigorous convergence guarantees under mild assumptions, notably eliminating the restrictive bounded heterogeneity condition. Empirical evaluation on standard image classification benchmarks validates the efficiency and robustness of our approach.

papers.title_en: MLOps-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Production ML Engineering in Real Repositories
papers.authors: Quoc Co Tran, Hitesh Laxmichand Patel, Diwakar Mahajan, Kshitij Bakliwal, Avi Sil, Katrin Kirchhoff
papers.evidence: 面向生产机器学习系统工程的基准
papers.tldr: 现有智能体评测多聚焦竞赛式建模或通用代码修复，难以衡量其在真实机器学习生产仓库中维护完整生命周期的能力。MLOps-Bench从31个开源仓库构建212项可执行任务，覆盖数据、训练、部署、监控、持续集成与治理，并以补丁和双类测试验证。六个智能体中最佳仅解决31.2%任务，虽通过68.7%测试，仍常只取得局部进展。该基准将评估推进到依赖生命周期推理、行为鲁棒性和既有功能保持的仓库原生MLOps工作。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly expected to modify and maintain machine-learning systems in production, yet existing benchmarks primarily evaluate either competition-style ML experimentation or generic repository issue resolution. We introduce MLOps-Bench, a repository-grounded benchmark for production ML engineering. Unlike prior ML-agent benchmarks, MLOps-Bench evaluates executable lifecycle changes inside real ML repositories, spanning data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, model serving, monitoring, CI/CD and governance, and end-to-end integration. Each task is grounded in repository evidence and includes a natural-language requirement, oracle patch, plausible buggy baseline, fail-to-pass tests, pass-to-pass tests, and provenance metadata. The benchmark contains 212 validated tasks from 31 public ML repositories, with 636 fail-to-pass tests and 856 pass-to-pass tests. We evaluate six agents and find that the best system solves 31.2% of tasks while passing 68.7% of tests, showing that current agents often make partial progress but still fail production-relevant behavioral requirements. MLOps-Bench shifts agent evaluation beyond model building and issue fixing toward repository-native MLOps work where correctness depends on lifecycle reasoning, behavioral robustness, and preservation of existing system behavior.

papers.title_en: SPADE-KD: Peer-to-Peer Collaborative Learning under Heterogeneous Settings
papers.evidence: 面向异构性的去中心化点对点分布式学习
papers.tldr: 点对点协作学习可避免中心聚合器的单点故障，却常受限于同构模型、共享公共数据或统一全局目标。面对模型架构和数据分布同时异构，SPADE-KD以完全去中心化的个性化知识蒸馏替代参数平均。其自适应蒸馏依据本地任务损失衡量来访模型优势并调节传输强度，再以效用驱动的同伴选择筛除低收益交换。联邦分类实验显示，该方法较朴素去中心化蒸馏损失更低、收敛更快，且两个组件联合优于单独使用。
papers.abstract_en: Peer-to-peer collaborative learning is an emerging distributed deep learning paradigm that eliminates the need for a central aggregator and disseminator, avoiding the single-point-of-failure and bottleneck issues they can bring. Many such approaches use parameter averaging, requiring clients to have homogeneous model architectures, whereas others use knowledge distillation as an alternative while leaning on shared public data or centralized control infrastructure. Many of these approaches also make a one-size-fits-all assumption, i.e., jointly training a single, globally optimal solution for all clients, when in reality, clients' underlying data distributions might differ such that a globally optimal solution may not be locally optimal for all clients. To enable collaborative learning in environments with both model architecture and data distribution heterogeneity, we present SPADE-KD -- a fully decentralized model distillation framework that optimizes collaboration towards personalized rather than global performance. SPADE-KD leverages two mechanisms -- adaptive distillation and utility-driven peer selection. Adaptive distillation modulates the strength of each incoming model transfer by the performance advantage of the incoming model compared to the native model measured by their task losses, such that a client will distill more aggressively from incoming models that outperform it on its own local data. Utility-driven peer selection uses the loss-informed utility derived from adaptive distillation to rank prospective partners, focusing on exchanges that measurably improve the local model while suppressing low-utility transfers. Using federated classification tasks, we demonstrate that SPADE-KD consistent outperforms naive decentralized distillation with lower loss and faster convergence and that its individual components are more effective together than independently.

papers.title_en: Train Locally, Learn Together: Distributed Multi-Agent Training via ADMM
papers.authors: Yiwei Chen, Changsheng Wang, Yicheng Lang, Qing Qu, Alfred O. Hero, Sijia Liu
papers.evidence: 基于共识ADMM的去中心化多智能体训练
papers.tldr: 多智能体系统的协同训练通常依赖中心化训练器汇总轨迹、梯度与优化状态，因而面临扩展性、韧性和数据本地性限制。论文将协作学习建模为带共识约束的有限和优化问题，并以共识ADMM交替执行角色本地更新和分布式通信聚合。实验表明，在受攻击代理场景中，HarmBench攻击成功率最高降低26.4%，推理性能与中心化训练相当。该工作为无需中心训练器的联合多智能体优化提供了优化理论支撑与实践框架。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) can outperform individual language-model agents by combining specialized roles, diverse reasoning processes, and collaborative decision-making. However, collaborative MAS training is typically centralized, requiring a common trainer to aggregate role-local trajectories and learning signals and maintain model and optimization states. This motivates a distributed multi-agent learning paradigm in which agents improve system-level capabilities through role-local learning and decentralized communication, paving the way toward scalable, resilient, and self-organizing MAS. To this end, we introduce, to the best of our knowledge, the first optimization-grounded framework for distributed MAS training based on consensus alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). We formulate collaborative MAS learning as a consensus-constrained finite-sum optimization problem, naturally lending itself to distributed optimization via ADMM. The proposed approach alternates role-local learning with inter-agent consensus using distributed communication protocols such as ring all-reduce, enabling joint optimization while keeping each agent's data and training state local. We evaluate our framework on distributed safety alignment and general reasoning tasks. Under compromised-agent settings, ADMM can reduce HarmBench attack success rate (ASR) by up to 26.4%, while achieving reasoning gains comparable to centralized training. These results show that distributed MAS training retains the benefits of centralized joint optimization without requiring a centralized trainer.

papers.title_en: A Multi-Step Inertial ADMM Algorithm for Federated Learning
papers.authors: Hao Li, Qingsong Wang, Xihong Yan, Chengcheng Yan, Deren Han
papers.evidence: 面向通信开销的联邦分布式优化算法
papers.tldr: 联邦学习中的 ADMM 虽适合分布式训练，却常受通信开销和设备异构影响而收敛缓慢。论文提出多步惯性联邦 ADMM 方法 MiFedADMM，在服务器每轮聚合后利用多个历史迭代构造高阶外推。作者对其单步变体在温和假设下证明收敛，并给出 O(1/K) 收敛速率。合成与真实数据实验显示，该方法相较现有方案具有更优性能，说明历史信息驱动的加速可提升联邦优化效率。
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning has recently emerged as an important paradigm for large-scale distributed model training, which can be naturally formulated as a class of distributed learning problems. The alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is a widely used approach for solving such problems. However, its practical performance is often hindered by significant communication overhead and system heterogeneity. In this paper, we propose a multi-step inertial ADMM algorithm, called MiFedADMM, for federated learning. The proposed method leverages multiple historical iterates on the server side to construct a higher-order extrapolation after each aggregation to accelerate the convergence behavior. Under mild assumptions, we establish convergence results for the single-step variant of the proposed method and derive an O(1/K) convergence rate. Numerical experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and improved performance of the proposed method compared with existing approaches.

papers.title_en: PACT: NVFP4 Data-Flow LoRA Fine-Tuning on Consumer GPUs
papers.authors: Lei Gao, Hossein Entezari Zarch, Chaoyi Jiang, Murali Annavaram
papers.evidence: 利用低精度内核和激活管理优化 GPU 微调的系统
papers.tldr: 消费级显卡上的语言模型微调受制于显存和算力：LoRA虽减少可训练参数，但冻结投影计算及反向激活仍是瓶颈。PACT以原生NVFP4矩阵乘法加速冻结层，并复用量化RMSNorm输出、以NVFP4保存门控和上投影激活。它保留BF16非线性输入，结合离线GPTQ校准及融合缓存内核控制误差和转换开销。在16GB RTX 5080上，系统实现更低显存和更快微调，同时保持有竞争力的任务精度，拓展了消费级硬件适配大模型的可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning language models on consumer GPUs is constrained by computation and memory. Although LoRA reduces trainable parameters and optimizer state, frozen projections remain expensive, and activations retained for backward can dominate memory usage. We present PACT, a LoRA fine-tuning system that accelerates frozen projections with native NVFP4 GEMMs while reducing quantization and dequantization overhead and limiting quantization error. To reduce activation memory, PACT reuses quantized RMSNorm outputs and saves gate/up activations in NVFP4 for backward. To limit numerical error, it preserves BF16 inputs for forward nonlinear operations and calibrates frozen weights offline using GPTQ adapted to NVFP4 scales and quantized activations. Fused nonlinear kernels and cached forward and backward weight layouts reduce quantization and dequantization overhead. Evaluations across multiple models and tasks on a 16\,GB RTX~5080 show lower memory usage and faster LoRA fine-tuning with competitive accuracy, enabling model adaptation on resource-constrained consumer hardware.

papers.title_en: ATEST: Adaptive Resource-Aware Test-Time Scaling for LLM Inference
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型推理的GPU争用感知资源管理
papers.tldr: 测试时扩展通过多次采样提升大模型推理，但固定采样预算既忽略题目难度，也无法应对 GPU 争用导致的动态能耗，同一四样本请求的能耗最高可增至4.1倍。ATEST将新增样本的预期收益与实时 GPU 成本联合决策；在线模式逐样本评估多数答案稳定性、监测负载并学习能耗。A100四项任务上，其在不超能耗预算下取得最高或并列最高准确率，并会随负载升高自动减少采样。该工作证明了无需离线标定的资源感知控制可提升不稳定部署环境中的推理鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by sampling multiple answers, but fixed sampling budgets ignore both query difficulty and the changing energy cost of inference under GPU contention. We measure up to a 4.1-fold increase in energy for the same four-sample query as GPU load rises. We present ATEST, a resource-aware TTS framework that jointly considers the expected value of additional samples and their current GPU cost. ATEST-Online, its default mode, requires no offline calibration: it incrementally generates samples, estimates the stability of the plurality answer, monitors live GPU conditions, and learns step energy cost online to decide when to stop. ATEST-Calibrated instead selects a per-query budget using offline accuracy and cost models, favoring deployments with stable loads. We evaluate both modes on four reasoning and question-answering datasets using Phi-3-mini on an NVIDIA A100 under controlled varying load, and test transfer to an NVIDIA L40S and Qwen2.5-3B. Across the four A100 datasets, ATEST-Online answers every query without exceeding the energy budget, while achieving the highest or statistically tied accuracy and reducing sampling as load increases. On GSM8K at high load, it achieves 60.0% accuracy with no deferrals, versus 44.0% accuracy and 42.4% deferrals for ATEST-Calibrated. Ablations show that online cost learning drives adaptation to load. Including offline profiling, ATEST-Online uses 42 times less GPU time and 48 times less energy than ATEST-Calibrated for the evaluated workload. Online control trades higher tail latency and lower throughput on short tasks for robustness under varying load; offline calibration remains competitive under stable conditions.

papers.title_en: StreamAhead: Real-Time Streaming Video Question Answering via Adaptive Precomputation
papers.authors: Haoyang Fan, Dhruv Parikh, Rajgopal Kannan, Viktor Prasanna
papers.evidence: 面向低延迟流式视觉语言服务的算法系统协同设计
papers.tldr: 流式视频问答需要在任意时刻到来的查询下保持低延迟，同时持续满足视频处理帧率；但传统方案为全部帧预建KV缓存，造成不必要的在线计算。StreamAhead按片段独立编码，并在视觉特征到KV缓存的多级表示间自适应预计算，仅在查询检索到相关片段后补全其KV缓存。系统利用离线成本画像，将片段计算与问答并发调度到异构CPU/GPU。该方法在准确率可比的前提下显著降低首词延迟，并建立帧率与响应延迟的新帕累托前沿。
papers.abstract_en: Real-time streaming video question answering with vision-language models must answer queries that arrive at any time with low latency while sustaining the video-processing rate required by the application. Existing systems construct key-value (KV) caches for the entire video as it arrives, although a query typically uses only a few of the preceding frames as evidence. This highlights a fundamental trade-off: performing more computation as video arrives reduces query-time computation but can increase processing lag, whereas deferring computation can increase the video-processing rate but requires additional query-time computation for retrieved content.   We present StreamAhead, an algorithm-system co-design that exploits this trade-off through adaptive precomputation: dynamically controlling how much computation to complete for each video segment before a query arrives. StreamAhead encodes video segments independently and lets each remain at a different representation level, from inexpensive visual features to costly KV caches, completing KV caches only for the retrieved segments when a query arrives. StreamAhead profiles offline the cost of advancing a segment to each representation level. Its runtime uses these profiles to schedule segment computation concurrently with query execution, pipelining it across heterogeneous CPU and GPU resources while maintaining the required video-processing rate. StreamAhead achieves accuracy competitive with state-of-the-art methods with up to 10.4x lower time-to-first-token (TTFT), and up to 5.9x lower TTFT than state-of-the-art streaming systems. It sustains 30 FPS with P95 TTFT under 0.5 s, and up to 57 FPS with P95 TTFT under 2 s. To our knowledge, StreamAhead is the first real-time streaming video QA system with competitive accuracy, setting a new Pareto frontier between video-processing rate and TTFT.

papers.title_en: Orrery: Modeling and Simulation of GPU-direct MPI Communication with SimGrid
papers.authors: Ahmad Moh'd Saleh A. Belbeisi, Amir Raoofy, Josef Weidendorfer, Majid Salimi Beni
papers.evidence: 面向加速集群的GPU感知MPI通信仿真
papers.tldr: 现代超算广泛采用GPU加速，GPU感知MPI的直接数据传输机制若未被准确建模，将限制HPC应用仿真的可信度。Orrery基于SimGrid的SMPI构建拦截层，对GPU内存分配、核函数、数据传输与MPI操作进行流式建模，无需实际GPU。它在MUSICA超算最多32个节点上以CUDA感知MPI微基准和Jacobi求解器验证，可复现关键通信机制。该工作为GPU直接通信场景下的软硬件协同设计提供了可扩展仿真工具。
papers.abstract_en: Simulation of HPC applications is an essential tool for analyzing system design trade-offs and enabling effective hardware--software co-design. As modern supercomputers increasingly rely on GPU acceleration, MPI implementations have evolved to support GPU-aware communication, enabling direct GPU data transfers. Modeling these mechanisms is therefore critical for simulating HPC applications on current systems. In this paper, we introduce Orrery, an interposition layer built on SimGrid's SMPI to model GPU-aware MPI communication using existing collective implementations and flow-based simulation. Orrery intercepts GPU memory allocations, kernel launches, data transfers, and MPI operations, and models their execution in SimGrid according to target system specifications, enabling simulation without requiring physical GPUs. We validate Orrery using CUDA-aware MPI microbenchmarks and a Jacobi solver on up to 32 nodes of the MUSICA supercomputer and demonstrate that it reproduces key GPU-aware MPI mechanisms.

papers.title_en: FedPix: Learning What to Share with Less Leakage in Federated Intelligence
papers.authors: Jingwei Zhao, Tiantong Sun, Yuanyuan Song, Jinhuan Guo, Zishuo Wei, Shengyu Huang, Ziyuan Ren, Wei Chen, Xiaojin Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向分布式联邦智能的通信设计
papers.tldr: 现有联邦智能多传输模型更新或中间表征，前者难以审计，后者可能泄露隐私且客户端生成成本高。FedPix让客户端上传紧凑、可视检查的图像表征，并利用这些表征在服务器端联合优化任务效用与抗重建能力。实验在四个图像数据集上将重建PSNR降至6.87 dB、合成PSNR降至6.74 dB，同时CIFAR-10客户端运行时间由1223秒降至49秒，分类精度仍具竞争力。该工作将联邦学习焦点推进到“哪些信息应离开客户端”，兼顾隐私、效率与可用性。
papers.abstract_en: Existing federated intelligence paradigms primarily focus on how models are trained or aggregated, while overlooking a more fundamental question: \textbf{what information should leave the client?} Existing methods often share model updates that users cannot easily inspect, or data representations that may reveal sensitive information. Moreover, generating these representations can be computationally expensive for resource-constrained clients. We observe that image classification does not require all the visual details needed to reconstruct the original image. This suggests that clients could share less information while preserving task performance. However, learning what to preserve is challenging when the server cannot access raw client data. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{FedPix}, which learns to share compact, visually inspectable images instead of model updates or intermediate features. The key idea is to use the shared representations themselves to learn what information should be preserved and what can be discarded. By balancing task utility and reconstruction resistance, FedPix enables the server to improve the representations without accessing raw client data, while keeping client-side computation lightweight. Extensive experiments on BloodMNIST, CIFAR-10, FashionMNIST, and MNIST demonstrate that FedPix achieves strong reconstruction resistance, with reconstruction PSNR as low as 6.87~dB and synthetic PSNR as low as 6.74~dB. Meanwhile, FedPix reduces client runtime by up to 96.0\% (from 1223~s to 49~s on CIFAR-10), while maintaining competitive classification accuracy of 99.18\% on MNIST, 89.97\% on FashionMNIST, 82.24\% on BloodMNIST, and 65.63\% on CIFAR-10.

papers.title_en: Sparse Federated Echo State Networks for Time-Series Classification via Smooth-L1 Regularization
papers.authors: Gengcheng Lyu, Manuel Röder, Frank-Michael Schleif
papers.evidence: 面向稀疏模型的二阶联邦聚合
papers.tldr: 面向边缘与物联网时序分类，标准回声状态网络虽轻量，却因稠密读出层带来模型存储、单样本推理和联邦下发开销。论文提出采用二阶可导平滑L1正则的SL1ESN，在集中式与联邦训练中均以牛顿法优化，并设计二阶联邦聚合。七个基准显示读出层可达75%—95%稀疏，多数任务准确率接近最强稠密基线，联邦更新数轮即可收敛。该方案以较小精度代价显著压缩通信与计算，适合资源受限部署。
papers.abstract_en: Echo State Networks (ESNs), as lightweight implementations of reservoir computing, provide efficient solutions for temporal data processing in resource-constrained environments. While standard ESNs offer computational efficiency, their dense readout layers inflate the stored model and the per-sample inference cost. This paper introduces a Smooth-L1 regularized ESN (SL1ESN) that promotes sparsity in the readout layer while preserving differentiability for gradient-based optimization. The method employs a twice-differentiable Smooth-L1 approximation compatible with Newton's method, which we exploit both for centralized training and for a second-order (Newton-step) federated aggregation scheme. Under a single fixed shrinkage threshold shared by every dataset and both settings, experiments on seven time-series classification benchmarks show that SL1ESN learns readouts that are $77$--$95\%$ sparse in the centralized setting and $75$--$95\%$ sparse in the federated one, while staying within $0.7$ accuracy points of the strongest dense baseline on five of the seven benchmarks in the centralized setting and within $1.6$ points on the same five in the federated one, and the second-order federated update converges in only a few rounds. The resulting sparsity compresses the stored model, the per-sample inference cost, and the server-to-client broadcast by a comparable factor. These results demonstrate the practical value of sparse readouts for edge computing and IoT deployments.

papers.title_en: Scalable Levenberg-Marquardt Training Framework for Deep Learning
papers.authors: Xianghao Wang, Johan Barthélemy, John Taylor
papers.evidence: 可扩展的深度学习二阶训练框架
papers.tldr: Levenberg-Marquardt算法在小型神经网络中收敛快、对架构更稳健，但雅可比矩阵随样本数和参数量膨胀，令其难用于大模型。论文提出多GPU分布式框架LeMA，以精确对偶形式消除对参数维度的内存依赖，并按分片在线并行计算雅可比。该方法可在无需PCG近似求解的条件下执行精确LMA步，在十亿参数卷积网络的8卡训练中取得7.97倍加速和99.7%强扩展效率。工作将LMA内存瓶颈由参数量二次方降至批大小二次方，为通用大规模网络训练提供了可扩展方案。
papers.abstract_en: The Levenberg-Marquardt (LMA) algorithm is a widely used nonlinear least-squares solver known for its rapid convergence. For small-scale neural networks, LMA provides better convergence and architectural robustness than first-order optimizers like Adam. However, LMA imposes prohibitive memory and computational costs. These costs are primarily from the Jacobian matrix, whose dimensions scale with both the number of samples and parameters. This bottleneck prevents its use in large-scale neural networks. Recent efforts scale LMA using preconditioned conjugate gradient (PCG) solvers to avoid materializing the Jacobian. However, PCG only approximates the solution, requiring many network propagations and a task-specific preconditioner. Other studies optimize LMA to reduce costs, but they restrict their methods to specific tasks or network architectures. As a result, LMA remains impractical for training general large-scale neural networks. In this paper, we propose LeMA, a distributed LMA algorithm for large-scale neural network training on multi-GPU platforms. Our contributions are twofold: First, an exact dual formulation of LMA removes the memory dependence on the parameter dimension. Second, a Jacobian sharding strategy computes Jacobian shards on the fly and in parallel to avoid materializing the full Jacobian. For large-scale neural networks, LeMA reduces the memory footprint of LMA from quadratic in the number of parameters to quadratic in the batch size. This makes exact LMA steps feasible for billion-parameter models without approximate PCG solves. Furthermore, for a convolutional neural network with 1,000,022,632 parameters on an 8-GPU node, LeMA achieves a 7.97x speedup over a single GPU, corresponding to a 99.7% strong scaling efficiency.

papers.authors: Wu S. Zihan, Brian A. Yuan, Guillaume Bellec
papers.evidence: 面向Transformer训练的内存优化方法
papers.tldr: 标准端到端反向传播需缓存全部中间激活，Transformer训练受显存限制；局部学习虽省内存却常损失精度。本文为每个Transformer块训练蒸馏式局部代理网络，以预测全局网络输出，并在代理中独立反传来近似真实梯度。理论上该方法在线性深层网络中精确，并对非线性残差模型给出梯度误差界。ViT的CIFAR-100实验显示其准确率—内存权衡优于其他局部算法，微调大语言模型时也快于同等内存的零阶方法。
papers.abstract_en: Local learning algorithms can reshape resource requirements of artificial intelligence. The memory bottleneck of standard end-to-end backpropagation lies in the need to store all network activations until the loss gradient has been propagated back through. Local learning avoids this, but typically at a cost in accuracy. We study how to achieve accurate and memory efficient local learning in transformers. For each transformer block, we train a local proxy network to predict the global network output via distillation. Gradients can be independently propagated through this local proxy while estimating well the backpropagation gradients. In theory, this approach is exact for deep linear networks; in non-linear residual models, the gradient error can be bounded when using the appropriate residual proxy. We verify this numerically and demonstrate that optimizing the distillation loss improves gradient estimation. Evaluating the performance of proxy propagation on CIFAR-100 in vision transformers, we find that it achieves a better accuracy/memory trade-off compared to other local algorithms. Finally, we show that the method is further relevant for fine-tuning large language models on a small memory budget. Our method trains faster and achieves higher performance than memory-efficient zeroth-order learning algorithms with comparable memory cost.

papers.title_en: Universal Distributed Feature Extraction Complementary to Side Information via H-Score
papers.authors: Yuan Xinjie, Dier Tang, Shao-Lun Huang
papers.evidence: 通信预算约束下的边缘到中心分布式特征提取
papers.tldr: 面向边缘节点上传平均特征、中心节点结合辅助侧信息进行参数估计的分布式系统，难点是提取对任意下游任务通用且不与侧信息重复的表示。论文在弱依赖条件下对联合函数空间作正交分解，利用典型依赖核条件加性部分的模态构造任务无关特征。进一步以分布式嵌套H-score学习该分解。结果表明，有限特征预算下的均方误差损失仅取决于任务在被舍弃低信息模态上的投影；预算充足时，对所有平方可积任务的一阶误差差距消失，为侧信息互补的通用特征提取提供理论与算法框架。
papers.abstract_en: This paper considers a distributed estimation system where edge nodes transmit averaged features to a center node for parameter estimation. A key challenge arises when the center node possesses auxiliary side information: how to design local extractors that are universally optimal for any downstream task, while avoiding redundancy with the side information. To tackle this problem, we orthogonally decompose the joint function space and demonstrate in the weak-dependence regime that the modal decomposition of the canonical dependence kernel's conditional-additive component yields optimal, task-independent features. We construct a distributed nested H-score to learn this decomposition and show that, under a limited feature budget, the mean-squared error (MSE) gap to the best task-specific features is determined solely by the task's alignment with the discarded, least informative modes, and vanishes to leading order for every square-integrable task once the budget is sufficient.

papers.title_en: Dataset-Level Regularization for Joint-Embedding Self-Supervised Learning
papers.evidence: 面向小批量训练的数据集级状态管理
papers.tldr: 联合嵌入式自监督通常只在当前小批次内估计表示分布正则项，导致小批量时梯度偏离全数据集目标、表征几何受批量大小牵制。本文提出批外正则化：在CPU维护数据集级状态，并为每个样本构造全局锚点以指导小批量训练。该方法用于SimCLR与SIGReg，在自然图像和生物医学数据上的分类、类别不均衡少数类识别、实例检索及持续预训练中均优于批内目标，且小批量增益最大。工作表明正则化几何可与小批量优化解耦。
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised joint embedding learning aligns representations of augmented views while regularizing their distribution to prevent collapse. Regularization aims to shape the overall representation distribution, but most joint embedding methods restrict its computation to the active minibatch. We propose out-of-batch regularization, which maintains a dataset-level state in CPU memory and uses globally constructed per-instance targets during minibatch training. Evaluated on natural images and biomedical datasets, these anchors approximate the full-dataset regularization gradient more faithfully than conventional minibatch estimation at small batch sizes. Applications to contrastive (SimCLR) and non-contrastive (SIGReg) approaches show consistent improvement over the corresponding in-batch objectives for image classification, minority-class performance under controlled imbalance, instance retrieval, and continued self-supervised pretraining, with the largest gains at small batch sizes. These results suggest that dataset-level regularization can be decoupled from minibatch optimization, making batch size an optimization choice that does not affect the geometry of the regularizer.

papers.title_en: ShiftQAT: Quantization-Aware Training for the Numerical Contract of a Fixed-Function Edge CNN Accelerator
papers.authors: Oguzhan Buyuksolak, Osman Erman Okman, Mehmet Gorkem Ulkar
papers.evidence: 面向边缘CNN加速器的训练工具链
papers.tldr: 固定功能边缘CNN加速器虽高效，却要求网络严格遵循逐张量、对称二次幂尺度、8位存储及单层静态移位等数值契约，常规量化训练难以完全满足。ShiftQAT通过量化感知训练静态传播激活尺度，处理残差、拼接和权重共享依赖，并联合约束权重与偏置网格。其在ImageNet上的W8A8精度损失与宽松方法相当，W4A8距全精度仅2.9个百分点，并在MAX78002实现低时延、低能耗推理。该工作提供了可直接部署的开源训练路径。
papers.abstract_en: Fixed-function CNN accelerators make edge inference fast and energy-efficient, but they execute only networks that obey a precise numerical contract. On the MAX7800x family, this contract requires power-of-two, per-tensor, symmetric scales, 8-bit activations and biases, integer-only arithmetic, and one statically configured shift per layer. We present ShiftQAT, the quantization-aware training (QAT) flow we developed for this family, which produces networks satisfying the contract by construction. It is the default training path of ai8x-training, the family's open-source training toolchain. ShiftQAT resolves residual, concatenation, and weight-sharing dependencies so that activation scales propagate statically and each layer's requantization reduces to one offline-configured shift. It also trains weights and biases on a joint power-of-two grid that fits the 8-bit bias budget. Among the compared methods, only ShiftQAT satisfies all of the contract's scaling constraints, including signed 8-bit activation storage. Even so, on ImageNet it matches the W8A8 accuracy drop of less constrained QAT methods and stays within 2.9 percentage points of FP32 at W4A8. On MAX78002 silicon, ShiftQAT-trained MobileNetV2 and ResNet-18 classify ImageNet images in 14.6 and 8.4 ms at 5.1 and 2.8 mJ per inference.
